messages:
sam: FYI found an exploit path in libfastkv (CVE-2026-1423) that can be triggered via malformed prefix data when KV cache is enabled. Affects runtime v1.2.x and earlier. Hosted patch available but we need backport guidance for Dedicated/Private.

anna: :eyes: can you paste the PoC or link? we need severity and whether it requires config change or code fix.

sam: PoC here: https://internal.redwood/sec/CVE-2026-1423
Summary: RCE via deserialization when cache key contains unvalidated metadata. Fix is a sanitize+strict-deser change in runtimes/kv_cache and a small API check.

devon: marked as HIGH. Hosted rollout will go out in 30m with emergency patch. For Dedicated/Private the constraints are: many customers pin images and some are air-gapped, others have custom branches. We'll need backport branches + signed images.

marta: onboarding note: at least two enterprise customers (AcmeBank, MedCatalyst) run Private on-prem bundles that include the runtime image and our KMS integration. They require an SBOM and CVE report before we push a patch. Ops will need to push to their registries or provide patch tarballs.

sam: proposed triage/prio:
1) Hosted (done) - immediate
2) Dedicated (reserved pools) - high, can push images to our repo then coordinate with customers that pull from our repo
3) Private (VPC/on-prem) - critical for customers that can't do air-gap builds; need per-customer signed image or guidance for local rebuild

anna: for Private, do we have an automated backport script? If not, we should avoid manual per-customer branches where possible.

devon: we have backport template script: tools/release/backport.sh but it assumes CI can reach upstream. For air-gapped, we must produce a customer-specific image artifact and a verification SHA. Steps I propose:
- create branch release/backport/CVE-2026-1423-1.2.x
- cherry-pick fix commit
- run full runtime integration tests (kv cache + KMS smoke)
- build images: runtime:v1.2.1-cve1423 and runtime:v1.2.1-cve1423-slim
- sign artifacts with our release key
- produce SBOM and short impact report

marta: also ensure audit logs include the CVE triage and who approved the backport. Customers will ask for KMS key rotation advice — recommend key rotation in KMS after patch, and rotate wrapped DEKs in config.

sam: code snippet for local backport (for reference):
```
git checkout -b release/backport/CVE-2026-1423-1.2.x origin/release-1.2
git cherry-pick <commit-sha>
./tools/ci/run_integration.sh --filter kv_cache
docker build -t registry.redwood/runtime:v1.2.1-cve1423 .
docker trust sign registry.redwood/runtime:v1.2.1-cve1423
```

devon: note: for customers using our private registries, ops will need to mirror the signed image to customer registry. For fully air-gapped sites we must provide an OCI tarball plus verification signature and SBOM.

ops-bot: Reminder: filing deployment ticket for AcmeBank private mirror. Ticket #OPS-5982 created.

sec-bot: CVE-2026-1423 added to vuln-triage board. Label: backport-required, severity: high.

marta: testing checklist additions: confirm KMS interactions unchanged (re-encrypt/decrypt calls), verify audit log entries for key usage, run fuzzing on deserializers.

sam: does anyone object to creating a single backport branch per minor release (1.2.x) rather than per-customer branches? reduces merge complexity.

anna: agree. per-minor backport branch, then per-customer image artifacts if needed.

devon: action items:
- sam: open backport PR + link to PoC
- ops: prepare per-customer image mirror plan (OPS-5982)
- marta: prepare SBOM + customer impact note
- sec: update incident report and audit log entries

sam: I'll open PR now and ping customers list. :shipit:

marta: pinging @customer-success to prepare comms for AcmeBank and MedCatalyst.

devon: final: add note to rollout runbook about KMS key rotation post-patch and ensure onboarding doc mentions how to verify image signatures locally (gpg/notation).
